description: This file defines the AppTheme class for theming a Flutter application, including color schemes, text styles, and component themes, as well as an AppColors class with color constants.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: Provides static theming configurations for the Flutter app, including darkTheme and color tokens.

classes.name: AppColors
classes.description: Contains color definitions used throughout the app, encapsulated as immutable properties.

methods.name: colors
methods.description: Returns an instance of AppColors with color tokens.

methods.name: darkTheme
methods.description: Constructs and returns a ThemeData object configured for dark mode with custom styles.
